starting_state.state: local_artifacts/experiments/EXP-0042/in-battle-active-speed6.mss; +$3A8F patched to $01 (Wait), a patch validated by EXP-0044 trial 9

expected_outcomes: last-un-gated-frame: every advance occurs on a frame where +$2F41 reads 0
work resolves past the gate: at least one domain advances on a gated frame
something else: the gate flickers, or a bounded drain over the first few gated frames
experiments.falsifying_outcome: For 'last un-gated frame': any domain advancing on a frame with +$2F41 = 1. For 'work resolves past the gate': no advance on any gated frame. If +$2F41 toggles every frame rather than holding, EXP-0044's readings were aliased.
